title: We're going to the swimming pool, right?
scene: 周末计划，他一项项确认。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: What is the plan for this Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We're going to the swimming pool, right?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Yes, but only after we eat lunch.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: The big pool or the small pool?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: We are going to the big one.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Are we bringing our floats with us?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Just the small float. And after the pool, maybe we can get ice cream.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: We're going to be really tired after all that.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Then ice cream is very likely, I think.

variations: "the pool" 换 "the park"；"after lunch" 换 "after nap"。
